messages.text: When does it ship?
Searched the catalog · Lucky Miner LG07

The LG07 is in stock at $89.10, so it ships within 5 business days of your order. It's listed as a Final Sale, so it can't be returned once you buy it.

It's a tiny 12 W Dogecoin and Litecoin lottery miner, and it costs pennies a month to run. Are you after a Doge miner, or still deciding between this and the Magic M. 40T for Bitcoin?
can i add  it to my cart, it says notify me when live
Read the lucky miner lg07 page
Built a cart

I've built a cart with the LG07 at $89.10. Here's your checkout link: (order link hidden)

The store's catalog lists it as in stock, but "Notify me" on your page can mean there's no stock for your region. If so, checkout won't let you finish with your address, and I was wrong to promise the 5-day shipping.

Which country are you shipping to?
canada
Opened a product
Updated the cart

The store lets me add the LG07 to a cart for Canada at $89.10, so you can buy it through this link even though your page shows "Notify me":
(order link hidden)

The real test is the shipping step at checkout. If it takes your Canadian address, it's in stock for you and ships within 5 business days. Shipping to Canada starts at $17.99, and remember it's a Final Sale.

Does checkout take your address?
This item is out of stock in your region and can't be ordered right now.
Searched the catalog · dogecoin litecoin scrypt miner
Searched the catalog · Hammer DC02 HeliumDeploy Edition

That message means the LG07 has no stock for Canada right now, so the "Notify me" button is your way to hear when it's back. I'm sorry the cart sent you that far for nothing.

If you want a Dogecoin miner you can try now, the closest in the catalog is the Hammer DC06 at $379.99. It does 330 MH/s on 105 W, about 30 times the LG07's hashrate. It's a pre-sale, so check the ship date on its page, and it's also a Final Sale.

Want me to set up a DC06 cart, or would you rather wait for the LG07?
what's the cheapest object you have on the website
Searched the catalog · miner

The cheapest item on the site is the Miner D. at $39.99, a cleaning tool for miners.

The cheapest miners are $99. One is the Harlo B1, which you looked at earlier. It mines Bitcoin at about 1.2 TH/s on 22 W, so power costs about $1.60 a month at 10¢/kWh. It also has a built-in screen, which makes it a nice first look at how mining works. The other is the Jingle Miner Solo Lite, also $99 for Bitcoin, but it's a Final Sale and slightly weaker at 1.2 TH/s on 23 W.

I'd go with the B1. Want me to set up a cart so you can check whether it ships to your Canadian address?
yes, B1 and miner duster
Built a cart

I've built your cart: the Harlo B1 at $99 and the Miner D. at $39.99, $138.99 before shipping and tax.

(order link hidden)

Enter your Canadian address at checkout. It will confirm both items ship to you and show the shipping cost and ship date before you pay.

Did it go through?
i would only like the B1 after reconsideration. is there any active promo codes or upcoiming ones?

I've taken the duster out. Your cart is now just the Harlo B1 at $99, plus shipping and tax:
(order link hidden)

There are no promo codes, and I can't tell you about future sales, so $99 is the price. For that you get a real Bitcoin miner with its own screen. It runs on 22 W, about $1.60 a month at 10¢/kWh. Every ten minutes it gets another small shot at a full 3.125 BTC block, for as long as it runs.
